title: Media Frame Widget will not display pictures from a standard SMB Network Share on a NAS, when given a standard path via dolphin.
line: Media Frame now shows the pictures in a folder on an SMB share or other network location.
explanation: Media Frame decided whether a path was a folder, and listed its images, with QDir, which only understands local paths. A folder on an SMB share (or any remote URL) was therefore added as a single file; downloading it failed and the frame stayed empty. The earlier fix for remote files (a893e86490) only covered single images dragged onto the widget. Remote folders are now listed with KIO (recursively, like local folders) and their images added as they arrive; remote image files are still added directly, and anything that can't be listed falls back to the old single-file handling.

commits.message:
applets/mediaframe: list remote folders through KIO

Folders on remote locations like SMB shares were checked and listed with
QDir, which only knows local paths, so they were treated as one broken
file and nothing was shown. List them with KIO instead and add the images.

BUG: 508225

media.caption: Media Frame set to a remote folder (webdav://127.0.0.1:18226/ with 4 images) stays empty; log: 'QML Image: Cannot open'.
Same widget and folder with the fix: the pictures from the remote folder are shown.

review.text: Using KIO::listDir/listRecursive for remote folders addresses the core QDir limitation cleanly and is well verified on WebDAV. However, falling back unconditionally to addRemoteFile() on any KIO error turns missing, denied, or offline-NAS remote folders into broken single-file entries, and active list jobs are not cancelled when MediaFrame is destroyed.
changes: In MediaFrame::addRemoteDir() (applets/mediaframe/mediaframe.cpp), only fall back to addRemoteFile(path) when job->error() is KIO::ERR_IS_FILE or KIO::ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ACTION; for other errors (such as ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST, ERR_CANNOT_CONNECT, or ERR_ACCESS_DENIED), log a warning and do not add the directory URL to m_allFiles.
Kill active jobs in m_listJobs inside MediaFrame::~MediaFrame() (instead of = default) so removing the widget cancels in-flight recursive remote listings.
Emit countChanged() once per KIO::ListJob::entries batch (when at least one image was added) rather than inside the per-entry loop, and honor KIO::UDSEntry::UDS_URL when present.

reviews.text: This fixes the remaining part of the report that cwo identified in c3: remote folders were judged and listed with QDir, so an smb:// folder became one broken 'file'. Listing them with KIO::listDir/listRecursive (hidden files excluded, like the local QDirIterator path), killing running list jobs in clear(), and falling back to the single-file path on error is a contained, sensible change in the right place, and QML's onHasItemsChanged picks up the asynchronously added images. Choosing file vs folder by matching the name against the image filters is a heuristic rather than a KIO::stat, and a pathList change to a remote-only folder may keep showing the previous image until the next timer tick, but neither blocks merging; the WebDAV evidence exercises the same KIO remote-URL path as SMB.
